title: Spiced Wild Mushroom Tikka Masala
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian dish featuring wild mushrooms in a rich and creamy tikka masala sauce, served over basmati rice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in alicha spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add unique sauce and kik, stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes or until sauce has thickened.
Season with garam masala and serve over basmati rice.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
